reproducibility_header: THE CONGREGATION-TEST v1 — the founder's thesis ('resources must CONGREGATE at the point of service to show the effect') tested against the cross-grain-artifact alternative. Built 2026-11-23 from city_component_annual_v1.jsonl (2,509 rows, basis-tagged, unit-fixed) + murders_all_v1.json + populations series. Within-city demeaned component test at annual grain (2015-2024 city arcs): the design the OH-88 county-grain null demanded. Panel = 28 city-years (Cincinnati 8 / Detroit 7 / St. Louis 7 / Memphis 6); the NYC 46-year component arc and Denver await murder-window overlap. Components: parks/libraries/health/housing/human_services per-city-lane; care_per_cap = sum of usable components / PEP population.

lag_arc.verdict: STRENGTHENS WITH LAG — the proactive signature the county-grain could not find

verdict: THE CONGREGATION-THESIS REPLICATED: the component-mix signal held at annual grain with the lag-arc strengthening (county-grain null = wrong conductor, not wrong signal). Direction-class only: n=28 pooled, 6-8 per city; Denver/NYC await murder-window overlap; housing flips in Detroit; no p-values claimed.
